newsitem.title: USA: Investor protests Gencor proxy tabulation.
newsitem.headline: Investor protests Gencor proxy tabulation.

text.p: A shareholder of Gencor Industries Inc said Tuesday he has protested the tabulation of proxies at the August 14 annual meeting of the company.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the investor, Josef Ross, said he voted his own shares and those for which he obtained proxies, but his candidate for a board seat, Robert Kashan, was declared defeated.
Instead, a management nominee, David Air, was elected, he said. Ross said he owned a 4.8 percent stake while proxies granted to him represented 30.9 percent of Gencor's common stock outstanding.

Ross said he voted the 35.7 percent holding against a management proposal to increase the company's authorized shares, saying it was not in the best interest of holders of common stock. The proposal was defeated, he said.
Ross is identified in the filing as president of Universal Trav-ler Inc, of Bronx, N.Y.
